title: Tests map
description: The tests map binds a frozen spec to its executable checks: which check covers which spec node, the exact command whose exit code is the verdict, the baseline every run is judged from, and the deliberate gaps. Produced by the test-writing session, frozen before the plan gate, locked during runs. Invariants checked by validate-tests-map.mjs: (1) check ids unique and never reused from retired; (2) acceptance names an existing check of kind acceptance; (3) every covers ref is a live node of the named spec (or 'scope'), and the spec block matches the spec file's name, version and freeze commit; (4) every spec behaviour and edge appears in some check's covers or in unverified, never both; constraints and interfaces uncovered are warnings; (5) unverified refs resolve and carry a human decision no later than this version; (6) frozen gates: commit present, baseline block present, every check's baseline.observed recorded; draft carries no commit; (7) previous_versions ascending, below version, files distinct; (8) each retired check's covers are remapped to a live check or listed unverified; (9) every check file and the fixture path fall under locked_paths.

commit.description: Hash at freeze. Present iff frozen (coded invariant).

run_all.description: Optional single command for a human sanity pass; machine consumers use per-check commands.

acceptance.description: The check whose green ends a run; must exist and be of kind acceptance.

id.description: Stable, never reused or renumbered. The join key for plan units, prompts, check outputs and the report.

name.description: Optional human label, no meaning; cross-reference by id only.

covers.description: Spec node ids this check verifies; 'scope' for the diff boundary.

command.description: Exact command; exit code is the verdict.

observed.description: Verbatim state at the baseline run. Required once frozen (coded invariant).

baseline.description: The full baseline run. Required once frozen (coded invariant).
